summary: The reel maintains a coherent flat 2D vector aesthetic with bold typography and clear thematic visuals. Some scenes suffer from duplicated background props, stiff character stamping, and inconsistent hand grips on the mate.

clean: The mate diagrams clearly illustrate bombilla placement and movement.
Character reactions match the narrative tone between cebador and drinker.
unclean: Shot 8: Five characters are identically lined up across a balcony edge without depth.
Shot 9: Two identical brick parrillas sit unnaturally side-by-side in the same room.

clean: Consistent color palette and clean typography across title cards and callouts.
Clear diagrammatic overlays with dashed arcs and locator tags.
unclean: Shot 1: Stark, empty purple backdrop contrasts with detailed interior scenes elsewhere.
Shot 8: 'SU TRABAJO' label tag is duplicated redundantly across two figures.

issues.problem: Hands clutching the mate appear as generic round stubs rather than fingers wrapping the side.
issues.fix: Use the standardized side-grip asset with fingers clearly curled around the gourd body.

issues.problem: Stiff line-up of five repetitive figures stamped flatly along the fence line.
issues.fix: Stagger characters naturally in depth and vary poses rather than a straight lineup.

issues.problem: Two identical brick parrillas are placed side-by-side indoors.
issues.fix: Replace the duplicate parrilla with a standard dining table or patio sideboard.

issues.problem: Dual 'SU TRABAJO' pill labels create visual clutter.
issues.fix: Display a single centered tag or remove the redundant clone.

learnings.rule: Avoid duplicating large focal props like parrillas or hearths within the same backdrop.
Ensure character hands clearly clasp the gourd contour rather than floating as simple discs.
